name: tauriMarkerAfterUnflushedFence
covers: N4: on Tauri the recovery exit writes its marker only after the fence write reported flushed; a fence write that did not reach stable storage must stop the exit before the marker

pending.reason: The Tauri semantic store reports every durable write flushed: it has no flush fault (the real backend tests drive the `flush.fault` hook of their own stand-in). The fault, a fence write that resolves flushed:false, and the restart that drops unflushed writes are the Tauri half of 2f-5. The schedule is written against the actor interface; its fault entry is not expressible until then and is not faked.

labels.H9: the exit waits for the fence write t: r: exit seed: the fence write must report flushed:false (fault to be added), the exit must end 'fence:not-durable' and write no marker
labels.N4: the flag is lost with the re-flush: a Tauri restart after the unflushed fence write: the boot re-flush must include the fence
